Fir_0_LOD0..2 and Fir_1_LOD0..2 are geometry-decimated derivatives of
the first two source trees, prepared with Tools/PrepareFir.py in Blender.

Downloaded through the official Poly Haven API. Tools/FetchForestAssets.ps1
selects source files and verifies their published MD5 checksums.
Models, maps and derived Unity materials retain this CC0 license.
